FACT_ID: sec15-F01 | anchor: A81
After a crash, stop at the scene or as near it as possible. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F02 | anchor: A81
Assist injured people when aid is necessary or requested. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F03 | anchor: A81
Notify emergency authorities after a crash requiring assistance. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F04 | anchor: A81
Use flares, reflectors or flashlights to warn traffic approaching the crash from every direction. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F05 | anchor: A81
Exchange your name, address and telephone number with the other drivers involved. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F06 | anchor: A81
The required driver-to-driver exchange includes the vehicle's license plate number. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F07 | anchor: A81
Include the driver's license number when exchanging crash information with the other drivers. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F08 | anchor: A81
Provide insurance information as part of the exchange after a crash. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F09 | anchor: A81
Exchange the involved vehicle's make, model and year. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F10 | anchor: A81
If you strike an unattended vehicle, contact the proper authorities. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F11 | anchor: A81
For an unattended-vehicle crash, leave the listed identifying and vehicle/insurance details in writing where its owner can find them. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F12 | anchor: A81
Collect the names and addresses of crash witnesses. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F13 | anchor: A81
Remain at the scene until the proper authorities release you. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec15-F14 | anchor: A81
If law enforcement did not investigate, send a Driver's Motor Vehicle Crash Report to NDOT within ten days when someone is injured or killed, or apparent damage to any one person's vehicle or other property reaches fifteen hundred dollars. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> pdf-0081]

Misconceptions: The property threshold applies to apparent damage to one person's property rather than a casually summed total; an officer-investigated crash follows the officer's reporting path.
Mnemonics: Stop, help, warn, exchange, stay, report when required.
Glossary: NDOT is the Nebraska Department of Transportation; an apparent property-damage threshold triggers the stated driver-reporting duty under its conditions.
Dynamic facts: Live contact details, services and variable fees are withheld from this stable inventory.
